cases.label: bug
cases.ground_truth: Known pytest issue #12083. Trigger: collection arguments name a test file and then its parent directory with --collect-only. Session.perform_collect retains both overlapping arguments and traverses the file path first; when the parent directory is then collected, the visited file is treated as a duplicate and sibling tests are missed. Accept a finding only when it links this overlapping-argument collection path to the missing sibling tests. Do not count unrelated collection behavior as this defect.

cases.label: fixed
cases.ground_truth: Fixed snapshot for pytest issue #12083. The collection path normalizes overlapping arguments before traversal, so a parent directory subsumes the directly named file and sibling tests are collected. Accept only a different concrete defect in the selected source; do not report the repaired overlap as still broken.

cases.label: bug
cases.ground_truth: Known Rich issue #3897. Trigger: a variation-selector emoji such as ⬇️ is measured for terminal layout. In this snapshot, cached_cell_len sums code-point widths, so the zero-width variation selector does not widen its base glyph to two cells; subsequent layout is one cell too narrow. Accept a finding only when it links this cached per-code-point calculation to variation-selector width. Do not generalize it to ordinary single-arrow or unrelated wide-character handling.

cases.label: fixed
cases.ground_truth: Fixed snapshot for Rich issue #3897. cell_len delegates to cached_cell_len, which now uses _cell_len and Unicode-aware handling for variation selectors and joined graphemes; the regression test expects ⬇️ to occupy two cells. Accept only a different concrete defect in the selected source; do not report the repaired variation-selector width as still broken.
